description.ja: 映画『機動戦士ガンダム ククルス・ドアンの島』より、ククルス・ドアンが搭乗するザクがＨＧシリーズに登場。
description.en: From the movie "Mobile Suit Gundam Cucurrus Doan's Island", the Zaku piloted by Cucurrus Doan appears in the HG series.

description.ja: 印象的な頭部をはじめ、機体各所の剥がれた装甲や欠損した動力パイプ部などを新規造形で再現。
description.en: The impressive head, peeled armor in various parts of the fuselage, missing power pipes, etc. are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ジオン公国軍サザンクロス隊の部隊章やコーションマークを収録した新規水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: A new water slide decal containing the unit insignia and caution marks of the Zeon Principality Army Southern Cross Corps is included.

description.ja: ●　ドアン専用ザクの機体形状を新規造形を交え徹底再現！
description.en: ● Thoroughly reproduce the body shape of Doan's Zaku with new modeling!

description.ja: 頭部、スパイクアーマー、ランドセルや機体各所の剥がれた装甲や動力パイプ部のパーツ欠損などを新規造形を交え再現。
description.en: The head, spike armor, backpack, peeled off armor in various parts of the fuselage, and missing parts of the power pipe are recreated with new modeling.

description.ja: 頭部
description.en: head

description.ja: 面長で印象的な形状の頭部を新規造形で再現。動力パイプ部のパーツ欠損に加え、側頭部・後頭部のディテールも細やかに再現。
description.en: The long and impressively shaped head is reproduced with new modeling. In addition to the missing parts of the power pipe, details on the sides and back of the head are also finely reproduced.

description.en: school bag

description.ja: バーニアのみえないランドセル形状を新規造形で再現。
description.en: The shape of the school bag that cannot be seen by the vernier is reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　納刀状態と抜刀状態を再現できるヒート・ホークと左平手パーツが付属。より表情豊かなポージングが可能！
description.en: ● Comes with heat hawk and left palm parts that can reproduce the sword sheathed and unsheathed states. More expressive poses are possible!
